capabilities: Build reading schedules from a target finish date and chosen reading days
Track daily reading chunks by page numbers or percent
Redistribute remaining pages across remaining days when you fall behind or catch up
Show a dashboard of active books sorted by urgency and a sidebar of books due today
Shelve completed and archived books and fill book details from note properties
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or later. The status bar pages-left indicator is desktop only; mobile support was added in 1.3.0 and tested on Android.
motivation: The author wanted an honest reading companion without gamification: "It won't gamify your reading or pretend you're 'crushing it' when you're three weeks behind."
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track books you are reading, schedule daily reading chunks, or see whether you are on pace to finish by a target date.
summary: Reading scheduler that builds daily reading schedules for books, tracks your pace in pages or percent, and adjusts plans when you fall behind or catch up.
